translation: If it does not stop, moxa the Zhangmen point. Wang Shuhe said: When the Belt Vessel is diseased, [pain] encircles the navel on left and right, with pain of the lower back and spine, rushing to the yin and thigh. Wang Haizang said: For infantile hernia (tui), one may moxa Zhangmen three zhuang and it will be cured, because it travels with the Belt Vessel in the region of the Absolute Yin, and the Greater Yin governs it.
